name: Toggle Switch Flip
easing: track draw EASE.inOut f0-14; knob spring pop f26+; label fade f6-18
bestFor: A setting/mode flipping from off to on ('Agent mode').
notSuitable: Anything that is not a binary state.
keyframeTable: track done, knob left, OFF label
knob moving right, track turning orange
rest: orange track, knob right, ON on the left
script: Pill track draws; label fades in.
At f26 the knob springs from left to right; the track fills #6B3A2E with orange outline; OFF becomes ON.
